items.title: The 5 Phases of a Project Management Plan

source_refs.note: Unnumbered topic The 5 Phases of a Project Management Plan (PDF 16-17, printed 13-14). The figure shows only the phase names; the one-line explanations of each phase are general project-management meaning and are flagged for review.

blocks.alt: Five coloured boxes in a row, Initiation, Planning, Execution, Performance monitoring and Project closure, sit above a timeline with numbered dots 1 to 5. Under each dot is a card with an icon: a light bulb, a laptop with a checklist, a rocket, binoculars and a party popper.
blocks.caption: The 5 Phases of a Project Management Plan (original drawing after the textbook's unnumbered figure).
